normalization_plan.reason: The implementation address parameter only exists as the delegatecall target of _delegate and should be folded into that function node.
newImplementation is the validated/stored argument of _setImplementation and has no independent semantics.
The newImplementation argument of _upgradeTo is immediately forwarded to _setImplementation.
The external newImplementation argument is only meaningful inside the upgradeTo entry point.
newImplementation of upgradeToAndCall is used solely as that function's upgrade and delegatecall target.
The data bytes parameter is only consumed by the delegatecall inside upgradeToAndCall.
newAdmin is an argument of changeAdmin that is passed to _setAdmin; merge into the changeAdmin function node.
_logic is the constructor implementation argument used to call _setImplementation on construction.
_data is the constructor initialization bytes consumed by the constructor delegatecall.
_admin is the constructor argument used by _setAdmin in the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
account is only the argument of the isContract library function and carries no separate semantics.
The local slot variable is a temporary alias for IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside _implementation.
The local adm variable merely holds the sload result inside _admin.
The local size variable only holds the extcodesize result inside isContract.
The local success variable only captures the delegatecall return value inside upgradeToAndCall.
